reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that ideation functions as a behavioral surrogate, enabling cognitive processing without full physical engagement. This is formalized through the isomorphism between \( \mathcal{B}_{\text{feint}} \) and \( \mathcal{B}_{\text{actual}} \), where the former approximates the latter in stimulus-response space. The equivalence principle \( \mathcal{A}(\mathcal{S}) \equiv \mathcal{R}_{\text{actual}} \) underpins Bayesian inference in GSI, while the efficiency ratio \( \eta = \mathcal{E}_{\text{actual}}/\mathcal{E}_{\text{feint}} \) enables GSE to model optimal behavioral strategies. These primitives form a closed-loop system where ideation informs belief updates, which in turn guide action selection. Failure modes arise when feints diverge from actual outcomes, or when energy efficiency breaks down under environmental stress. Dualities emerge in the symmetry between cognitive and physical behavior, and the distinction between active and passive behavioral modes.
